Semilandmarks along pixel outline

https://drawwing.github.io/Semilandmarks-along-outline/SaO.html

Author
Affiliation

Adam Tofilski

University of Agriculture in Krakow, Poland

Published

2026-11-04

Libraries

# calculations
library(geomorph)  # GPA 
library(shapes)  # procGPA
library(tidyr)  # pivot_longer

# plotting and visualization
library(ggplot2)  # plots
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_light())
library(ggpubr)  # ggarange

Variable names

p <- 21  # number of landmarks
k <- 2  # number of dimensions, in this case 2 for coordinates (x, y)

# define which landmarks are connected by lines in wireframe graph
link.x <- seq(from = 1, to = p - 1)
link.y <- seq(from = 2, to = p)
links <- cbind(link.x, link.y)

EqD - Equidistant semilandmarks

Uncorrected semilandmarks are equidistant along the pixel outline.

GPA

inEqd <- read.csv("https://zenodo.org/records/23911653/files/EqD.csv", row.names = 1,
  sep = ";")
colony <- substr(rownames(inEqd), 1, 6)
colony <- gsub("KR-00", "colony", colony)
table(colony)
colony
colony1 colony2 colony3 
     30      30      30 
threeDEqd <- arrayspecs(inEqd, p, k)
dimnames(threeDEqd)[[3]] <- rownames(inEqd)
gpaEqd <- gpagen(threeDEqd, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)
xyAll <- matrix(aperm(gpaEqd$coords, c(1, 3, 2)), nrow = prod(dim(threeDEqd)[c(1,
  3)]))
colnames(xyAll) <- c("X", "Y")
plotData <- cbind(xyAll, landmark = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[1]), dim(threeDEqd)[3]),
  specimen = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[3]), each = dim(threeDEqd)[1]))
plotMean <- as.data.frame(gpaEqd$consensus)
figAliA <- ggplot(plotMean, aes(x = X, y = Y)) + geom_path(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_fixed() + geom_text(aes(label = rownames(plotMean)), nudge_y = 0.02) +
  geom_point(plotData, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(plotMean, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_void()
figAliA

varExp <- data.frame(PC = seq_along(pcaEqd$d), var = as.numeric(varTab["Proportion of Variance",
  ]))
figHistA <- ggplot(varExp, aes(x = PC, y = var)) + geom_col(color = "black", fill = "white") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Proportion \nof variance") + xlim(0, 22) + ylim(0, 0.6)
figHistA
pcaScoresEqd <- as.data.frame(pcaEqd$x)
colnames(pcaScoresEqd) <- gsub("Comp", "PC", colnames(pcaScoresEqd))
pcaScoresEqd <- cbind(pcaScoresEqd, colony)

# create plot labels
variance <- varTab["Proportion of Variance", "Comp1"]
variance <- round(100 * variance, 1)
labelX <- paste0("PC1 (", variance, "%)")
variance <- varTab["Proportion of Variance", "Comp2"]
variance <- round(100 * variance, 1)
labelY <- paste0("PC2 (", variance, "%)")

figPcaA <- ggplot(pcaScoresEqd, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, shape = colony, color = colony)) +
  geom_point() + scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c(1:3)) + scale_color_manual(name = "",
  values = rainbow(3)) + stat_ellipse() + labs(x = labelX, y = labelY)
figPcaA

SaT - samilandmarks along tangent

Semilandmarks corrected along tangent.

GPA

# create matrix used for sliding semilandmarks
slidingMat <- cbind(before = seq(from = 1, to = p - 2), slide = seq(from = 2, to = p -
  1), after = seq(from = 3, to = p))
slidingMat
      before slide after
 [1,]      1     2     3
 [2,]      2     3     4
 [3,]      3     4     5
 [4,]      4     5     6
 [5,]      5     6     7
 [6,]      6     7     8
 [7,]      7     8     9
 [8,]      8     9    10
 [9,]      9    10    11
[10,]     10    11    12
[11,]     11    12    13
[12,]     12    13    14
[13,]     13    14    15
[14,]     14    15    16
[15,]     15    16    17
[16,]     16    17    18
[17,]     17    18    19
[18,]     18    19    20
[19,]     19    20    21
gpaSat <- gpagen(threeDEqd, curves = slidingMat, ProcD = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE,
  PrinAxes = FALSE)
xyAll <- matrix(aperm(gpaSat$coords, c(1, 3, 2)), nrow = prod(dim(threeDEqd)[c(1,
  3)]))
colnames(xyAll) <- c("X", "Y")
plotData <- cbind(xyAll, landmark = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[1]), dim(threeDEqd)[3]),
  specimen = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDEqd)[3]), each = dim(threeDEqd)[1]))
plotMean <- as.data.frame(gpaSat$consensus)
figAliB <- ggplot(plotMean, aes(x = X, y = Y)) + geom_path(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_fixed() + geom_text(aes(label = rownames(plotMean)), nudge_y = 0.02) +
  geom_point(plotData, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(plotMean, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_void()
figAliB

SaO - samilandmarks along outline

Semilandmarks corrected along pixel outline

GPA

inSao <- read.csv("https://zenodo.org/records/23911653/files/SaO.csv", row.names = 1,
  sep = ";")

threeDSao <- arrayspecs(inSao, p, k)
dimnames(threeDSao)[[3]] <- rownames(inSao)
gpaSao <- gpagen(threeDSao, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)
xyAll <- matrix(aperm(gpaSao$coords, c(1, 3, 2)), nrow = prod(dim(threeDSao)[c(1,
  3)]))
colnames(xyAll) <- c("X", "Y")
plotData <- cbind(xyAll, landmark = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDSao)[1]), dim(threeDSao)[3]),
  specimen = rep(seq_len(dim(threeDSao)[3]), each = dim(threeDSao)[1]))
plotMean <- as.data.frame(gpaSao$consensus)
figAliC <- ggplot(plotMean, aes(x = X, y = Y)) + geom_path(size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  coord_fixed() + geom_text(aes(label = rownames(plotMean)), nudge_y = 0.02) +
  geom_point(plotData, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 0.5, color = "blue") +
  geom_point(plotMean, mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_void()
figAliC

rhoEqd <- procGPA(gpaEqd$coords)
rhoEqd <- rhoEqd$rho

rhoSat <- procGPA(gpaSat$coords)
rhoSat <- rhoSat$rho

rhoSao <- procGPA(gpaSao$coords)
rhoSao <- rhoSao$rho

rhoEqd <- data.frame(Semilandmarks = "EqD", rho = rhoEqd)
rhoSat <- data.frame(Semilandmarks = "SaT", rho = rhoSat)
rhoSao <- data.frame(Semilandmarks = "SaO", rho = rhoSao)

rho <- rbind(rhoEqd, rhoSat, rhoSao)
rho$Semilandmarks <- factor(rho$Semilandmarks, levels = c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"), labels = c("Equidistant",

Wing shape

inAll <- inEqd
tmp <- as.data.frame(two.d.array(gpaSat$coords))
colnames(tmp) <- colnames(inAll)
inAll <- rbind(inAll, tmp)
inAll <- rbind(inAll, inSao)

threeDAll <- arrayspecs(inAll, p, k)
dimnames(threeDAll)[[3]] <- rownames(inAll)
gpaAll <- gpagen(threeDAll, print.progress = FALSE, PrinAxes = FALSE)

semilandmarksAll <- c(rep("EqD", 90), rep("SaT", 90), rep("SaO", 90))

colonyAll <- substr(rownames(inAll), 1, 6)
colonyAll <- gsub("KR-00", "colony", colonyAll)

gdfAll <- geomorph.data.frame(gpaAll, colony = colonyAll, semilandmarks = semilandmarksAll)
lmAll <- procD.lm(coords ~ colony * semilandmarks, data = gdfAll)
summary(lmAll)

pv <- data.frame(EqD = pvEqd$Procrustes.var, SaT = pvSat$Procrustes.var, SaO = pvSao$Procrustes.var)
pv$colony <- factor(1:nrow(pv))

pvLong <- pivot_longer(pv, cols = c(EqD, SaT, SaO), names_to = "Semilandmarks", values_to = "PV")
pvLong$Semilandmarks <- factor(pvLong$Semilandmarks, levels = c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"),
  labels = c("Equidistant", "Along tangent", "Along outline"))
figVB <- ggplot(pvLong, aes(x = Semilandmarks, y = PV/1e-04, group = colony, colour = colony)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Procrustes variance (" *
  10^{
    -4
  } * ")")) + scale_color_manual(values = rainbow(3)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,
  3.5), expand = c(0, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "top")
figVB
pd <- data.frame(EqD = pdEqd$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdEqd$means.dist$obs)], SaT = pdSat$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdSat$means.dist$obs)],
  SaO = pdSao$means.dist$obs[upper.tri(pdSao$means.dist$obs)])
pd$colony <- factor(c("1-2", "1-3", "2-3"))
pdLong <- pivot_longer(pd, cols = c(EqD, SaT, SaO), names_to = "Semilandmarks", values_to = "PD")
pdLong$Semilandmarks <- factor(pdLong$Semilandmarks, levels = c("EqD", "SaT", "SaO"),
  labels = c("Equidistant", "Along tangent", "Along outline"))
figVC <- ggplot(pdLong, aes(x = Semilandmarks, y = PD, group = colony, colour = colony)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Procrustes distance") + scale_color_manual(values = rainbow(3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.02), expand = c(0, 0)) + theme(legend.position = "top")
figVC
figV <- ggarrange(figVA, figVB, figVC, labels = c("a", "b", "c"), font.label = list(size = 10,
  face = "bold"), ncol = 1, nrow = 3)
